newsitem.title: USA: Consumers shuts Mich. nuke for planned work.
newsitem.headline: Consumers shuts Mich. nuke for planned work.

text.p: Consumers Power Co shut its 780 megawatt Palisades nuclear power plant over the weekend as expected for scheduled refueling and maintenance, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was scheduled to be shut about 50 days, returning to service near December 20, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The Palisades plant is located in South Haven, Mich.
Separately, Consumers' 67 megawatt Big Rock Point nuclear power plant was operating at 64 percent of capacity and was increasing power as of early Monday, the NRC said in the status report.
Big Rock Point, located at Charlevoix, Mich., was shut Oct 23 to correct a problem with a computer program.
Consumers Power is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
